title: A Vagueness Index for Frontier Safety Policies

original_idea.body: A vagueness index for frontier safety policies (METR; arXiv:2512.01166): score every commitment sentence with an LLM-as-judge rubric (falsifiable vs aspirational), validate against hand labels, produce a per-policy vagueness leaderboard. Public docs only.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A reproducible vagueness metric pressures labs toward verifiable commitments; strong, governance-relevant chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Public docs + LLM-as-judge rubric scoring + hand-label validation; accessible, no ML training.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped per-policy vagueness index with a clear rubric and validation.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public documents, no lab access, policymaker-facing tool; strong counterfactual value.

novelty.reasoning: Systematic vagueness measurement across policies not yet done; mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Vagueness never measured systematically across policies.
